propositions: Four read-only metric functions must be implemented in git_metrics.py: module_size_distribution (scans .py modules against single hard cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt), cap_change_events (git log history of limit file changes), churn (git log --numstat insertions/deletions), and refactor_to_addition_ratio (deletions/insertions returning None when insertions is zero).

Each metric must be registered in REGISTRY with MetricSpec entries that have lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', accruing_since='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', and a context-adapter compute lambda.

Unit tests must verify exact-value assertions: module_size_distribution returns correct count, max_loc, and over_cap_count against fixture modules; cap_change_events returns list[dict] with old_limit/new_limit or empty list; churn returns exact insertions/deletions; refactor_to_addition_ratio returns exact ratio or None.
All four metric ids (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be verifiable in REGISTRY by iterating and checking .id, .lens, and .source attributes.
